integrity: Analytic whole-domain proof with a standalone exact symbolic and numerical checker. No external independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns i.i.d. maxima of the original 2023 invertible bimodal Gumbel distribution at fixed parameters and p>1. The negative-mode Weibull law is conditional on a probability tending exponentially to zero; unconditional maxima have the usual Gumbel limit. Historical priority is qualified by incomplete global literature coverage.
title: A rare Weibull boundary layer beneath persistent bimodality of Gumbel block maxima
